title: PhishIR synthetic plus public-email extension v1
description: One JSONL record. Synthetic records unchanged; public records email-only with unknown response/entity/campaign truth.

synthetic.title: PhishIR-Synthetic v1 record
synthetic.description: One synthetic email plus a single endpoint-context snapshot, not an independent real-world incident. Gold fields must not be model inputs.

id.description: Unique record identifier. Metadata only; excludes from model features.

split.description: Fixed 800/100/100 split; disjoint lure families and matched pairs.

family_id.description: Gold scenario-family metadata for leakage checks, not an input.

pair_id.description: Matched benign/phishing pair; stays in the same split. Not a model input.

email_text.description: Only permitted input for phishing classification: subject, sender domain and body.

text.description: Email plus endpoint narrative. Input for extraction and response evaluation. All entity offsets index this field.

phishing_label.description: Gold: 1 = malicious social-engineering request; 0 = authorized benign workflow. Endpoint compromise alone does not make an email phishing.

endpoint_state.description: Gold scenario metadata, never an input.

correlated_compromise.description: Gold containment eligibility for the EMAIL host, based on malicious endpoint evidence on the same host within 60 minutes. Does not prove email caused compromise.

response_label.description: Gold benchmark policy, not production authorization. Host isolation and identity handling require organizational approval.

entities.description: Gold exact non-overlapping observable spans. These are not verdicts of maliciousness. URL contains its domain; no nested DOMAIN span.

observable.description: Permitted response inputs; synthetic event metadata, not gold labels.

minutes_after_email.description: Relative event time in minutes; null when no endpoint event is available.

annotation_basis.description: Truth originates from scenario construction, not analyst adjudication.

email_text.description: Only permitted classification feature; transformed subject and body. Other fields are metadata/gold.

phishing_label.description: Source-provided phishing membership or non-spam proxy, not independent expert truth.

source_record_index.description: Zero-based original mbox message order or CSV data-row index, not sampled-row order.

source_record_sha256.description: Checksum of reserialized parsed MIME message or sorted-key CSV row JSON; full source hashes are in source_manifest.json.

template_group_id.description: Inferred normalized/near-duplicate component; NOT a verified campaign identifier.

campaign_id.description: Unavailable for public emails; null does not mean negative, benign, no action, or no entities.

endpoint_state.description: Unavailable for public emails; null does not mean negative, benign, no action, or no entities.

correlated_compromise.description: Unavailable for public emails; null does not mean negative, benign, no action, or no entities.

response_label.description: Unavailable for public emails; null does not mean negative, benign, no action, or no entities.

entities.description: Unavailable for public emails; null does not mean negative, benign, no action, or no entities.
